from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
d=Path('reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1')
sources=d/'sources'
render=d/'renders'
render.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
exe=Path(r'E:\CodexData\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\poppler\Library\bin\pdftoppm.EXE')
assert exe.is_file()
rows=json.loads((d/'合格固定利率付息券公告候选.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['rows']
receipt=[]
for row in rows:
    p=sources/row['pdf_filenm_announcemt']
    prefix=render/p.stem
    png=prefix.with_suffix('.png')
    assert not png.exists(),'该页已经渲染，不重复'
    command=[str(exe),'-png','-r','120','-singlefile',str(p.resolve()),str(prefix.resolve())]
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
    assert result.returncode==0 and png.is_file()
    receipt.append({'pdf':str(p),'png':str(png),'command':command,'return_code':result.returncode,'font_substitution_warning':bool(result.stderr),'visually_checked':False})
    node=ET.parse(sources/row['xml_filenm_announcemt']).getroot()
    values={x.tag.split('}')[-1]:(x.text or '').strip() for x in node.iter() if x.text and x.text.strip()}
    selected={k:values.get(k) for k in ['SecurityTerm','OriginalSecurityTerm','SecurityType','OfferingAmount','AnnouncementDate','AuctionDate','IssueDate','OriginalIssueDate','MaturityDate','Reopening','FloatingRate','InflationIndexedSecurity']}
    print('原XML',row['cusip'],json.dumps(selected,ensure_ascii=False))
(d/'原公告渲染回执.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pages':receipt,'complete_pdf_pages':7,'renderer':'现有Poppler，120dpi'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('七份原公告已渲染，等待逐页读取；未拟合或读取股票收益。')
